CombatStart.Name: Clear all targets when combat starts
CombatStart.Hint: When an encounter begins, every player's targets are cleared.

CombatEnd.Name: Clear all targets when combat ends
CombatEnd.Hint: When a started encounter is ended, every player's targets are cleared.

TurnStart.Name: Clear targets at the start of a turn
TurnStart.Hint: When a combatant's turn begins, the targets of the player(s) who own it are cleared. On a turn of a combatant no player owns, the GM's targets are cleared.

TurnEnd.Name: Clear targets at the end of a turn
TurnEnd.Hint: When a combatant's turn ends, the targets of the player(s) who own it are cleared. On a turn of a combatant no player owns, the GM's targets are cleared.

AfterAttack.Name: Clear targets after an attack or spell
AfterAttack.Hint: When an attack card (a weapon, feature or reaction that deals damage or calls for a save) or a spell card is posted to chat, the targets of the user who posted it are cleared.
